name: print-social-red-grid-system-condensed-type-post
title: Red Grid System Cover Post
whatItIs: A saturated red portrait post overlaid with a visible pale grid, a huge condensed 'GRID' in yellow over 'SYSTEM' in white, a subtitle, geometric shapes and a looping arrow.
whatItMeans: The visible grid demonstrates the topic itself. Red, yellow and white are loud and confident.
techniques: Draw the grid you are talking about
Condensed heavy caps in two colors as a stacked headline
Basic shapes (square, circle, triangle) as a visual glossary
bestFor: Content that needs to grab a scroll

vocabulary.definition: Layout gridlines shown as part of the design.
Narrow letterforms that allow very large headlines.
Circle, square and triangle used as basic building blocks.
